|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2023/group/14 |title=MAC Basketball Standings - 2022-23 |website=ESPN|access-date=March 5, 2023}} They finished tied for ninth in the [[2022–23 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC]] and failed to qualify for the [[2023 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]]. ==Previous season== {{main|2021–22 Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball team}} The [[2021–22 Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 10–21 and
